excerpts.content:
Made a couple updates to the EraE format:
- reused same e2store types as defined in era1, where applicable
- receipts are now optional, if a client chooses 
- clarified how the merge transition should be handled for pre-merge fields, i.e. TotalDifficulty and AccumulatorRoot
PTAL: https://hackmd.io/@matt/eraE/edit
